tips.text: Take the Amesha Archwing for the Golem; it heals you and keeps energy topped up.
Leave explosive and grenade Archguns like Ayanga and Arbucep at home; they do near-zero damage on the Golem.
Bring a direct-fire, high fire-rate Archgun such as Mausolon, modded for Heat and Slash.
Circle behind the Golem and shoot the engines on its back, its only weakpoint; dodge the gas trail.
Fight the Golem solo; it scales, so a weak build or an uncoordinated squad drags it out.
Run earlier Archwing missions for mods first if the fight stalls you.
Gather the 2 Argon Crystals only when you are ready to craft the Chassis; they decay.
Expect the Golem to be a slog of about 5 to 15 minutes, not a difficulty wall.
